hardware_precision_info: Precision Mode is controlled by the physical hardware button beside the trackball.
custom_shortcut_placeholder: Command, e.g. alacritty or wtype -M ctrl -k c
recording_active: Press keys on keyboard... (Esc to cancel)
recovery_link_reported: Bluetooth reports connected. Check that the pointer moves.
recovery_disconnect_timeout: MX Ergo did not disconnect. Try again.
recovery_connect_timeout: MX Ergo did not reconnect. Check channel 2, then try again.
recovery_unavailable: The saved MX Ergo or Bluetooth adapter is unavailable.
recovery_target_seen: Saved address seen in this scan.
recovery_target_not_seen: Saved address not seen in this scan; BlueZ may still have seen it.
recovery_other_multiple: Several other MX Ergo addresses seen; none was changed.
recovery_scan_ended: Bluetooth scan ended before reconnection finished.
recovery_cleanup_failed: Could not stop this scan. Recovery remains blocked until it exits.
recovery_cancel_unconfirmed: Could not confirm that the connection stopped. It may still complete; check Bluetooth status before retrying.
reconnect_hint: Automatically reconnects Bluetooth link when computer wakes up
shortcut_input_placeholder: e.g. SUPER + 8, CTRL + C, ALT + F4...
low_latency_hint: Administrator authorization required. Affects every device on this adapter and persists after plugin removal. Improvement is not guaranteed.
battery_estimate_hint: No verified charge reading is available.
battery_reported: Approximate level. Exact charge percentage is unavailable.
latency_setup: Install the optional system helper using the README instructions.
latency_legacy: Old profile: original settings were not saved. Cleanup removes its rules; restart the computer afterwards.
latency_restart: Restart the computer before enabling a new profile.
latency_restore_pending: Rules removed. Restore settings when the original adapter is available.
settings_load_error: Saved preferences could not be read. The file is preserved; repair it before saving changes.
settings_save_error: Changes could not be saved. The previous file is unchanged.
settings_apply_error: Could not apply the button or pointer settings.
resume_monitor_error: Sleep monitoring stopped. Automatic reconnection may be unavailable.
profile_create_hint: Name the new profile. Its five assignments are copied from the current profile.
profile_delete_confirm: Delete profile “%1”? Another profile will be activated first.
profile_shortcut_hint: One key with optional modifiers. Leave empty to disable. An existing binding will not be replaced.
profile_switch_all: Use this button to switch in all profiles
profile_invalid_shortcut: Use one supported key with optional SUPER, CTRL, ALT or SHIFT.
profile_switch_failed: Profile could not be applied. Restoring the previous profile…
profile_rollback_failed: Could not restore the previous profile. Button assignments are unverified; retry.
profile_shortcut_conflict: This shortcut conflicts with an existing binding. Choose another combination.
assignment_preset_hint: Choosing an action applies it immediately.
assignment_draft_hint: Unapplied draft · press Apply to save.
assignment_apply_hint: Press Apply to assign this value.
assignment_edit_hint: Change the value, then press Apply.
assignment_empty_hint: Choose a button on the mouse diagram to change its action in the selected profile.
pointer_scope: These settings apply to every button profile.
assignment_apply_error: Button assignment could not be confirmed. Try again.
